name: Armor of Whalebone
descriptionTemplate: Hand Limit +1. At the start of combat or after playing {derived:Bone of Blades}, place 1 {derived:Bone of Fury} into hand and shuffle 1 {derived:Bone of Agony} into Draw Pile. If {derived:Bone of Fury} and {derived:Bone of Agony} are both played in the same turn, combine these two cards into {derived:Bone of Blades} and place it into hand.
lore: The bones of Leviathan shield Its chosen, rendering them invincible and immortal.
